language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hi, my name is Paula and I am an airline pilot. I love flying!
I was flying over the Bermuda Triangle at the Atlantic Ocean, and all of a sudden I lost control of my airplane! What happened then? I don't remember, I just woke up on this unknown island.
The Bermuda Triangle is famous because a lot of airplanes and ships have disappeared here mysteriously.
This island is beautiful. It's full of different kinds of animals. We humans have many things in common with other animals. For example, we both eat and sleep to survive.
But there are also differences between humans and animals. Look at the fish, they breathe under water.
Parrots, like all birds, fly with their wings. I wish I was a bird! Then I wouldn't need an airplane to fly!
Let's tour the island and meet more animals. I'm sure we can discover more similarities and differences between humans and animals!
